title: When the Inheritance Wakes
author: Quentin Sterling
blurb: Beatrix Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
